verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs say it connects ERP and accounting systems and builds statements "off live actuals from your ERP", with actuals that "flow in" without copy-paste. That covers the core of automated actuals ingestion. However, the pack never names QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite, and it is unclear whether a founder can set up the connection without help. A community commenter raised the self-service onboarding question, but nothing answers it. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, documentation of sync cadence and self-serve setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my accounting platform (QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite) and actuals land in the model without manual exports

citations.quote: Abacum builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live actuals from your ERP
ERP and Accounting Systems: Easily analyze your revenue, expenses, financial statements, or consolidations.
Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself. No copy-paste between the model, the slides and the memo.
